One scale, 0.013393 px/unit (27.43 px font size), puts the digit height on the PNG's (ink 20.27-40.30 px, baseline y 40.034); the "1" starts at the PNG's left ink edge (x 9.239), the "3" ends at its right ink edge (x 51.725) - overall width and centre as in the PNG - and the "2" is centred on the PNG's "2" (x 29.704). The PNG itself is "123" in Arial Bold, a proprietary font: Roboto's digits differ in detail (shorter flag on the 1, slightly wider 2 and 3), so the mean difference is about 5. Roboto 3.x is under the SIL OFL 1.1 instead; the 2.x releases, 2.137 here, are Apache-licensed
